services.title: Kubernetes GitOps Continuous Deployment
services.description: Kubernetes GitOps with ArgoCD/Flux: declarative manifests, per-environment state diffs, drift detection, promotion pipelines, image policy (admission webhook), and OIDC-native RBAC.
features: GitOps reconcile loop — every k8s resource in the repo, diff vs live state shown
Per-environment manifest overlays: dev, staging, prod without duplicate configs
Drift detector — alert + auto-reconcile within 60 seconds when config diverges
Image policy admission webhook + OIDC-native RBAC per env and namespace
benefits: Declarative k8s configs = no more 'it works on my cluster' incidents
Drift detector actively repairs — no manual kubectl diff required k8s
Promotion pipeline = one-button dev-to-prod with audit history
Image policy webhook blocks unapproved images at admission time

benefits: Reduce change-failure rate 50-80% via declarative GitOps + audit trail

services.title: Real-Time Time-Series Analytics Platform
services.description: High-throughput real-time analytics for IoT, monitoring, and business metrics: stores, aggregates, and queries billions of events per day at <200ms p99 latency. Includes alert rules, anomaly detection, SQL + Python query engine, dashboards, and Grafana/PostgreSQL-compatible endpoints.
features: Ingestion: 1 million+ events/second per cluster with exactly-once guarantees
Down-sampling + retention policy: raw for 7 d, 1-minute roll-ups for 90 d, hourly for 3 y
SQL query engine + Python SDK for time-series queries in one familiar language
Alert rules: threshold, rate-of-change, compound condition — Slack, PagerDuty, Email, Webhook
Grafana + PostgreSQL wire-protocol: connect existing dashboards in 2 minutes
benefits: Query 10 billion time-series events in under 2 seconds — no pre-aggregation required
P99 query latency <200 ms means SLA dashboards feel instantaneous to ops teams
Alert fatigue drops 60% vs dumb-threshold alerts because anomaly-detection rules adapt to seasonality
